declaredIdentity: tenant/type-ii-observation-calendars/programId; stable periodId and exact opening intent. Amendment retries compare exact intent. Release of any already inactive period returns success without comparing closed snapshot, so changed release facts can be acknowledged as old success.
invariant: Active program Type II date ranges, including both current and reserved amendment ranges, must never overlap; a pending amendment must finish or cancel before date range release.
boundaryRationale: Splitting period reservations by period without a shared admission owner breaks non-overlap. Retain program-wide reservation owner; keep only active ranges/pending holds, project inactive histories. If sharding by date buckets becomes necessary reserve all intersecting buckets in canonical order and recover/release partial reservations.
identityReadingRule: selectedIdentitySummary and exact selectedCommandContracts define intended identity. baselineIdentityObservation/declaredIdentity retain older source observations only, including old replay defects; they are not target behavior or authorization to change an occupied key.

logicalIdentity.rule: deterministic receiver identity derived from the admitted root fact, episode and generation: exact redelivery resolves the original result, a changed admission is a new identity

selectedCommandContracts.guard: Accepted exact intent before calendar acquisition; hold both old/new ranges until applied; same program guard prevents overlap.
selectedCommandContracts.failure: Exact replay returns original result; proven superseded operation is terminal no-op; unavailable dependency/unknown append is transient; changed intent or invalid proof is permanent conflict/quarantine.

selectedCommandContracts.guard: Exact applied/close-frozen/cancellation-fence proof; release old or closed range only, never an unrelated/new reservation.
selectedCommandContracts.failure: Exact replay returns original result; proven superseded operation is terminal no-op; unavailable dependency/unknown append is transient; changed intent or invalid proof is permanent conflict/quarantine.

baselineIdentityObservation: tenant/type-ii-observation-calendars/programId; stable periodId and exact opening intent. Amendment retries compare exact intent. Release of any already inactive period returns success without comparing closed snapshot, so changed release facts can be acknowledged as old success.
identityContractRule: Existing published owner identity/IdFor remains stable. Required typed creation/operation identity and tenant/program/source scope come from the selected signature/protocol references; no context.RequestId minting fallback or guessed new stream key.
selectedIdentityClarification: Tenant / type-ii-observation-calendars / ProgramId. Every active reservation remains bound to exact PeriodId/opening intent; release/cancel/close operations retain exact selected period, generation and terminal source proof.
selectedIdentitySummary: Tenant / type-ii-observation-calendars / ProgramId. Every active reservation remains bound to exact PeriodId/opening intent; release/cancel/close operations retain exact selected period, generation and terminal source proof.
selectedReplayRule: Current required authorization precedes replay; exact authorized retries resolve the original accepted result using the selected logical identity and immutable actor/intent/source binding. Fresh mutable feasibility, clock selection and body preparation cannot replace that original result. Expected revision is concurrency precondition, not a new identity.
commandNote: ApplyTypeIIPeriodRange is in the same process but mutates TypeIIPeriod, not the calendar.
